title: Brinjal Spice Powder Fry
description: Brinjal cooked soft in oil, then tossed in a freshly roasted and ground coriander-dal spice powder.

items: 2 tbsp Urad dal (split skinless black gram)

steps.title: Roast spice base
steps.text: Heat 4 tablespoons of oil. Sauté coriander seeds, 3 tbsp chana dal, 2 tbsp urad dal, dried red chillies and fenugreek seeds. Towards the end, add asafoetida and turmeric powder.

steps.title: Grind
steps.text: Remove from heat and allow to cool completely. Blend into a coarse powder using a mixer/grinder.

steps.title: Sauté brinjal
steps.text: Heat 6 tablespoons of oil in a tawa or pan. Add mustard seeds, 2 tbsp chana dal and 2 tbsp urad dal. Add the chopped brinjal and sauté. Add 1 teaspoon of salt.

steps.title: Cook covered
steps.text: Cover with a lid and cook on medium-low heat until the brinjal turns soft and yellowish-cooked in oil.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add the prepared coarse spice powder and stir well until the brinjal is evenly coated.

tips: Add the asafoetida and turmeric at the very end of roasting so they don't burn.
